Class GroupeTD

java.lang.Object
GroupeTD
public class GroupeTD extends Object
GroupeTD with a name, a Promotion, a list of Module and a list of Etudiant. Can add a Student to it's list, a Module to it's list and compare two GroupeTD to check if they are equal.
Author:
G.REBECHE
